confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attack (failed logins) to a successful unauthorized login from an unusual IP, followed by privilege escalation, bulk cross-departmental data exfiltration, and log tampering to hide tracks.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt via multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (23.129.64.222) during off-hours.
Successful login from the same unusual IP, establishing a session.
Unauthorized privilege escalation to an admin role.
Bulk exfiltration of sensitive files across multiple departments (Finance, Sales, Legal, Engineering, and Shared projects) using the elevated privileges.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion of authentication logs to conceal the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether user_09's actual credentials were compromised or if the account was hijacked via another method.
Information on whether the IP 23.129.64.222 is associated with a known malicious actor or VPN/Tor exit node.
narrative: An attacker successfully performed a brute-force attack against user_09's account from an external IP during off-hours. After gaining access, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, exfiltrated a large volume of sensitive data from multiple departments, and attempted to cover their tracks by deleting authentication logs.
